feature.title: PF2e Damage Dice
feature.hint: Gives every PF2e damage roll 3D dice that look like the damage — colour, texture, relief and glow chosen by damage type, across all sixteen types. Needs Dice So Nice.

appearance.name: Damage dice treatment
appearance.hint: How much of the damage-type look to apply to 3D damage dice.
appearance.full: Full — colour, texture, relief and glow
appearance.surface: Surface — colour, texture and relief, keep my dice set

font.name: Use the bundled dice numeral font
font.hint: Sets damage dice numerals in Google Sans Code Bold, bundled with the suite. Turn this off to keep whatever font your dice set already uses.

glow.name: Glow strength
glow.hint: Multiplies the emission map on damage types that light up — fire, electricity, force, vitality and the rest. 0 turns the glow off entirely. Needs Dice So Nice's realistic lighting to be on.

persistent.name: Mark persistent damage
persistent.hint: Persistent damage rolls its dice hotter — brighter numerals, glowing edges — so a bleed tick reads differently from the hit that caused it.
